evidence: The bitmap has exactly two disconnected material components.
Each component is a single waveguide routed from a separated port into a close, long parallel interaction region and then back out to a separated port.
The central rails are nearly horizontal, separated by a sub-wavelength gap; there are no junctions, crossings, resonators, or closed loops.
topology_reasoning.working_principle: Light launched into either guide couples to the neighboring guide through evanescent overlap while the two guides run in parallel. The transferred power is primarily set by coupled-mode splitting and interaction length, with S-bends serving as access fan-in/fan-out.
function_defining_knobs: coupling_length: length of the close parallel section and primary transfer-ratio knob
coupling_gap: edge-to-edge gap between the two central rails
wg_width_top and wg_width_bottom: guide widths that set mode confinement and coupling strength
port_pitch and coupled_pitch: separated-port spacing and central coupled-guide spacing
bend_radius and fanin_length: access bend adiabaticity and footprint
delta_length: upper-arm trim knob included for HOMI verify_knob_response contract
topology_reasoning.geometry_model: Build two gf.Path centerlines using smoothed S-bends and straight central rails, then extrude them on layer (1,0). No raw polygons or device stencils are used; only path extrusion plus primitive rectangles for optional bbox anchors.

iterations.change_made: Initial two gf.Path smoothed routes with constant-width extrusions; diff showed straight diagonal access sections and underfilled curved bends.
Replaced waypoint smoothing with sampled Bezier centerlines; diff improved but bends remained too shallow and pitches too large.
Tightened port and coupled pitches and widened guides; comparison-threshold slice analysis showed the access bends still needed near-vertical shoulders.
Moved Bezier controls to create near-vertical bend shoulders; route match improved, but slice centers showed left shoulder too early and right shoulder too late.
Shifted left shoulder later and right shoulder earlier; remaining errors concentrated in bend halo/edge thickness, so final iteration will add localized bend-width overlays.
Added localized wider path-extrusion overlays on access bends. IoU improved via higher recall, while SSE worsened due extra bend material; kept as best IoU after six-iteration limit.
